data: Which method reaches the highest accuracy in figure 3?

The caption states that the figure shows the accuracy of three methods: C&W, word2vec, and the radical-enhanced model, with K=10. The question asks which method reaches the highest accuracy in the figure. From the analysis of the graph, the yellow line representing the radical-enhanced model starts at approximately 0.75 on the y-axis and decreases gradually, while the red line for C&W and the green line for word2vec remain relatively flat around 0.2 and 0.3, respectively. Therefore, the radical-enhanced model reaches the highest accuracy in the figure.
